question:

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6aa84c28107de1d378cc3853d32f3d40bbdd59c44eba6e8a46bee3f79945b121.png] The positions of 'F' & 'U' is interchanged.

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba9ce318aebf31e540202843013327c0e8a9d2cda62fe1c89120db287b9483dd.png] The combination is correct.
